artifacts.title: Keynote Speech: Quo Vadis TBVC?
artifacts.summary: Keynote address, delivered at a conference, Nwanedi Resort, Republic of Venda, 1990.10.30 - 1990.11.01. Accompanied by letters: Had referred to FVZS in his opening address; conference was successful and attended by [Bantu] Holomisa, [Oupa] Gcozo and [Gabriel] Ramushawana, as well as representatives from Inkatha, Nafcoc, the Conservative Party and the ANC. Sends a “prognosis of Africa” and a summary of opinion polls showing the extent of Black support [for government]. Found his piece on Africa particularly instructive; will let him have a copy of his new book on South Africa.
